preconditions.description: The sizes of the two partitions (a, b) and the number of edges (m) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= a and 1 <= y <= b for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Every edge connects a valid vertex from the first partition (1 to a) to a valid vertex from the second partition (1 to b).
There are no multiple edges between the same pair of vertices.

postconditions.expression: c == max(max((deg_u[u] for u in range(1, a + 1), default=0), max((deg_v[v] for v in range(1, b + 1), default=0)))
postconditions.description: The minimal number of colors c equals the maximum degree of any vertex in the bipartite graph.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in colors)
postconditions.description: Every assigned color is an integer between 1 and c inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(colors[i] != colors[j] for i, j in ((i, j) for i in range(m) for j in range(i + 1, m) if (edges[i][0] == edges[j][0] or edges[i][1] == edges[j][1])))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent edges (sharing a common vertex) have the same color.
The output contains exactly m color assignments corresponding to the input edges.
